parts:
Is it possible to have label within annotate reference some other
value, for example, 1st row of 1st col in a matrix

messages.author: a9413cb4eedc9e12
messages.subject: Re: annotate labels
parts:
It seems so

df1  <-  data.frame(id = c("a", "b", "c"), catb = c(3,2,5))
colours  <-  c("red", "blue")
ggplot(df1, aes(id, catb)) + geom_point() +
       annotate("text", x = 1, y = 2, colour = colours[2], label = "Hi there")
